deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Controls whether the resource can be deleted through Terraform. Policies should require a protective value such as PREVENT to reduce the risk of accidental or unauthorized deletion.

description.rationale: Human-readable description only. It does not affect security, permissions, or resource behavior.

display_name.rationale: User-friendly display name only. It has no impact on security or access control.

entry_group_id.description: The entry group id of the entry group.
entry_group_id.rationale: Identifies the entry group resource. It is a resource identifier and does not configure security controls or permissions.

labels.description:
User-defined labels for the EntryGroup.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are used for organization and filtering. They do not enforce permissions or protect resources.

location.description: The location where entry group will be created in.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Specifies the GCP project that owns the resource. It is a project reference rather than a configurable security control.
